hook: NVIDIA releases Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, 14 open continuous-diffusion language model checkpoints
hookText: NVIDIA releases Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, 14 open continuous-diffusion language model checkpoints

beats.say: Each token becomes a point in a 16-dimensional embedding space; the model adds Gaussian noise and learns to remove it block by block, which makes few-step distillation and steering practical.
On NVIDIA's six-task suite Sigma-8B base averages 71.16 versus 70.22 for its discrete-diffusion NLD-8B, but the instruct model trails slightly and AIME25 is only 17.
▲ NVIDIA just released Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, 14 continuous diffusion language model checkpoints at 3B and 8B that denoise text the way image models denoise pixels.
